sentences.text: On 1.27, finished Jobs can be cleaned up automatically by specifying the `.spec.ttlSecondsAfterFinished` field, which the TTL-after-finished controller uses to delete the Job after the TTL expires.

citations.quote: You can use this mechanism to clean up finished Jobs (either `Complete` or `Failed`) automatically by specifying the `.spec.ttlSecondsAfterFinished` field of a Job
